title: Fighting Bias with Bias: Promoting Model Robustness by Amplifying Dataset Biases

bias_targets.target: Dataset bias (Spurious correlations and Annotation artifacts)
bias_targets.methodology: Partitioning datasets into 'biased' and 'anti-biased' subsets using three model-based approaches: dataset cartography (analyzing training dynamics/confidence), partial-input baselines (e.g., hypothesis-only models for NLI), and minority example detection via deep clustering. Models are evaluated on their ability to generalize to anti-biased test sets after training on bias-amplified splits.

primary_bias_target: Dataset bias (Spurious correlations and Annotation artifacts)
